subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Which part of this broad architecture request should OpenClaw core own first, and which parts should be delegated to existing compaction, context-engine, plugin, or ClawHub paths?
rationale: Current main partially improves AGENTS.md bootstrap relevance and exposes compaction/context-engine seams, but choosing a generic relevance algorithm or promoting observation extraction into core requires maintainer architecture intent.

options.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
options.body: Use this issue as an umbrella only until maintainers create or confirm focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as a parent architecture discussion and block automated repair until one track is prioritized.

options.title: Supersede After Relinking
options.body: Close this issue only after bootstrap and compaction are fully covered by narrower items and observation extraction is confirmed outside core.
